若以下两段不同语言的文字对应相同含义，请回答”相同“，否则回答”不同“

文本1：决定要在哪里进行足浴，然后调暗那里的灯光。播放让你放松的音乐。如果你喜欢，还可以点一些蜡烛，备齐所有用具，放在触手可及的地方。你需要毛巾、磨砂膏、身体乳液、袜子或拖鞋。  你可以在卧室、浴室、客厅等任何地方进行足浴。 禅宗音乐、古典音乐和大自然的声音都能让人放松下来。不过，每个人对音乐的品味都不一样。如果重金属音乐最能让你放松，那就选择它吧！ 如果你想要通过足浴振奋精神，选择有窗户的房间，打开窗帘，让自然光照射进来。 塑料盆的大小必须足够让双脚轻松地泡在里面。想要打造更奢华的体验，可以使用高度达到你小腿一半的盆。如果你真的很讲究，也可以使用专门的足浴盆。 考虑在盆底放一些弹珠或光滑的石头。把双脚放在上面滚来滚去，好好地按摩一番！ 先用干净柔软的毛巾拍干双脚。然后将一些身体乳液涂抹在脚上。要是没有身体乳液，可以用润肤霜、身体油或荷荷芭油代替。穿上一双棉袜锁住保湿霜，最好穿一整夜。 如果你想要给双脚做美甲，那就不需要穿袜子。 用搓脚刷清洁脚趾甲底下的皮肤，然后用指甲剪修剪脚趾甲。用干净的毛巾擦干双脚，用洗甲水擦拭脚趾甲，清除残留在上面的油。接着涂上底油，然后是你喜欢的指甲油，最后涂上透明亮油。等上一层干了再涂下一层。  涂指甲油之前，可以先用角质推棒将角质推回去。 涂了指甲油后，建议等待至少45分钟才可以穿包鞋。
文本2：Decide where you want to have your foot spa, then dim the lights. Put on some music that you find relaxing. Light some candles, if desired, and make sure that all of your supplies are close by and ready to use. This includes your towels, scrubs, lotions, and socks or slippers.  You can have your foot spa anywhere you want: bedroom, bathroom, living room, etc. Zen music, classical music, and nature sounds are all very relaxing. Everyone is different, however; if you find heavy metal to be the most relaxing, then go for it! If you want an invigorating foot spa instead, choose a room with windows, then open the curtains to let in the natural light. Any plastic container that is big enough to fit both of your feet will do just fine. For a more luxurious experience, make sure that the tub is tall enough to reach halfway up your calves. You can also use one of those tubs made specifically for foot spas if you really want to get fancy. Consider adding some marbles or smooth stones into the bottom of the tub. This way, you can roll your feet over them and give yourself a foot massage! Pat your feet dry with a soft, clean towel first. Next, massage some body lotion to your feet. If you don’t have any lotion, you can use body butter, body oil, or even jojoba oil instead. Seal the moisturizer in by putting on a pair of cotton socks. It would be best to leave these socks on overnight. Skip the socks if you will be giving yourself a pedicure. , if desired. Clean under your toenails with a manicure brush, then trim them with nail clippers. Dry your feet with a clean towel, then wipe your toenails with nail polish remover to get rid of any oils. Apply a base coat, follow up with your desired nail polish color, then seal it with a clear topcoat. Let everything dry before moving on.  If you need to push back your cuticles, do so with a cuticle pusher or orange stick before you apply the nail polish. It's recommended that you wait at least 45 minutes before wearing any closed-toe shoes after polish application.
